maddeler.e:
احترمت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَمْتُ (iḥtaramtu) /iħ.ta.ram.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اِحْتَرَمْتَ (iḥtaramta) /iħ.ta.ram.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اِحْتَرَمْتِ (iḥtaramti) /iħ.ta.ram.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَرَمَ (iḥtarama)
# اِحْتَرَمَتْ (iḥtaramat) /iħ.ta.ra.mat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
